app.title: Chiku
live.title: Chiku Live
welcome.greeting: Hi! I am Chiku. I want to see you!
camera.title: Shall Chiku open his eyes?
camera.kidLine: Then Chiku can watch you wave, smile and count on your fingers!
camera.promise: Grown-ups: a camera is used only on this device, only while you play. Nothing is recorded, nothing leaves this device.
camera.blocked: Chiku's eyes stayed closed — we can still play by tapping!
warm.title: Chiku is getting his eyes ready…
warm.kidLine: Just a moment — the camera is still off!
warm.grownup: Grown-ups: Chiku is copying his eyes onto this device. This happens once, it can take a minute on a slow connection, and the camera stays off until it is finished.
warm.failedTitle: Chiku could not find his eyes
warm.failed: Shall we try again? We can play by tapping too!
warm.failedGrownup: Grown-ups: the on-device vision files could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again — the whole game still works without the camera.
camera.offNote: Chiku's eyes are off. Tap your answer — Chiku loves that too!
act.fingers.retry: So close! Hold your fingers up high for Chiku.
act.wave.retry: Big slow waves! Chiku is watching your hand.
act.smile.retry: An even bigger smile! Chiku will smile back.
talk.noEars: Chiku's ears do not work on this device — show him or tap your answer instead!
praise.nudge: Nearly! Let's try that one together.
praise.effort.one: You kept trying! And you did it!
praise.effort.two: That one was hard, and you did it!
praise.effort.three: You tried and tried. Chiku is so happy!
streak.label: Stars
goodbye.title: Bye bye! Come back soon!
goodbye.capTitle: That is all our play time for today!
goodbye.capLine: Chiku had so much fun with you. See you next time!
session.arcLabel: How much play time is left today
grownup.title: For grown-ups
grownup.limitNote: When the time is up Chiku says goodbye and the game ends. There is no way to ask for more from inside the game.
cloud.explainOff: Grown-ups: this browser cannot understand speech on the device itself. You can turn on Chiku's internet ears — then what your child says is sent to the browser's speech service (Google) to be understood. Chiku keeps nothing. Off means talking stays off; showing and tapping always work.
cloud.explainOn: Grown-ups: Chiku's internet ears are ON. What your child says is sent to the browser's speech service (Google) to be understood. Hold below to turn them off.
cloud.holdOn: Hold to turn on internet ears
cloud.holdOff: Hold to turn off internet ears
